blocks.orig: Tanzania travel just got easier with the new Zanzibar Airport! Abeid Amani Karume International Airport, previously known as Kisauni Airport or Zanzibar International Airport, is Zanzibar’s main airport. The airport is located about 5 km south of Zanzibar City – the vibrant capital of Tanzania’s beach paradise. The majority of international flights from East Africa, Europe and the Middle East arrive at this airport as their gateway to Tanzania.
blocks.html: Thanks to the new Zanzibar Airport, getting around Tanzania has become simpler. The main airport on Zanzibar is Abeid Amani Karume International Airport, once called Kisauni Airport or Zanzibar International Airport. You will find it roughly 5 km south of Zanzibar City, the lively capital of Tanzania’s beach haven. Most international flights coming in from East Africa, Europe and the Middle East land here, using it as their entry point to Tanzania.

blocks.orig: With Zanzibar’s increasing popularity, the Tanzanian government has undertaken the task to refresh the old airport with a new, modern and much more functional international Terminal. This is fantastic news for travellers to Tanzania, opening up the paradise island of Zanzibar to more awesome adventures. The new airport facilities will increase the number of travellers able to efficiently pass through every day, as well as provide improved travel services.
blocks.html: As Zanzibar’s popularity keeps growing, the Tanzanian government has set about renewing the old airport by adding a modern international Terminal that works far better. For anyone travelling to Tanzania this is very good news, as it makes the island paradise of Zanzibar more accessible for even more adventures. With the new facilities, more travellers can move through the airport smoothly each day, and the travel services on offer will be better too.

blocks.orig: As of December 2021, Terminal 1 is currently inactive, with Terminal 2 serving as the airport office and for domestic flights. Terminal 3 is quickly nearing completion. Once finished, the brand-new airport will officially open to international travellers by the summer of 2022. Not only does the new airport deliver a fantastic and fresh welcome to the start of travellers’ journey’s to Tanzania, but will offer a range of useful new services for travelers.
blocks.html: Since December 2021, Terminal 1 has been out of use, while Terminal 2 handles domestic flights and houses the airport office. Work on Terminal 3 is close to being finished. When it is done, the new airport is set to open its doors to international travellers by the summer of 2022. Besides giving a fresh and pleasant welcome at the outset of travellers’ journey’s through Tanzania, the new airport will also bring a variety of practical new services for travelers.

blocks.orig: Among the new travel services coming soon to travellers to Zanzibar International Airport is free Wi-Fi throughout the whole terminal and a dedicated client service centre. Other improvements and services include:
blocks.html: Free Wi-Fi across the entire terminal and a dedicated client service centre are among the new services that travellers flying into Zanzibar International Airport can soon look forward to. Further upgrades and services include:

blocks.orig: air conditioning in both arrivals and departures
blocks.html: air conditioning in the arrivals and departures halls
airport management outsourced to a high standard,
more elevators and better access for disabled travellers

blocks.orig: aeroplanes disembarking right at the terminal (so no bus needed!)
blocks.html: passengers leaving the aeroplane directly at the terminal (no bus required!)
